summary: Add a paired-owner authenticated, strictly validated Opal UV policy endpoint and client contract that cannot issue a WLED mutation until the canonical shared policy can run on the installed Opal runtime.

scoped_evidence.approved_architecture_reference: Existing paired Owner PWA, authenticated Opal local control gateway, canonical AUX UV policy, and hardware fail-dark gates; follows existing /api/aux/control route and does not create a controller or raw WLED path.
scoped_evidence.affected_subsystem: Cart local Owner control client and staged Opal local-control package only.
scoped_evidence.rollback_reference: Revert this source commit. No device, production, or configuration mutation is part of this change.
scoped_evidence.limitations: The installed OpenResty/Lua runtime cannot load the existing Deno JavaScript policy module. The endpoint validates and returns 503 with mutationIssued:false; no local UV actuation or hardware acceptance is claimed. Existing UV hardware profile and physical commissioning gates remain closed.
